verses.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਲੀਨ ਜਲ ਮੀਨ ਗਤਿ ਸੁਖਮਨਾ ਸੰਗਮ ਹੁਇ ਉਲਟ ਪਵਨ ਕੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: sabadh surat liv leen jal meen gat sukhamanaa sa(n)gam hui ulaT pavan kai ||

en.bdb: Just as a fish swims through towards upstream swiftly, so does a disciple of Guru engrossed in the Guru's word crosses the confluence of all the three veins (Irha, Pingla and Sukhmana) with the methodology of reverse breathing/air.

verses.gurmukhi: ਬਿਸਮ ਬਿਸ੍ਵਾਸ ਬਿਖੈ ਅਨਭੈ ਅਭਿਆਸ ਰਸ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਮਧੁ ਅਪੀਉ ਪੀਐ ਗੁਹਜੁ ਗਵਨ ਕੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: bisam bisavaiaas bikhai anabhai abhiaas ras prem madh apeeau peeaai guhaj gavan kai ||

en.bdb: Becoming fearless in the strange devotion and love, engrossed in the practice of Naam Simran and reaching there through strangely mysterious ways, one drinks deep the loving eternal nectar.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦ ਕੈ ਅਨਹਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਕੈ ਉਨਮਨੀ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਕੈ ਨਿਝਰ ਧਾਰ ਸਹਜ ਰਵਨ ਕੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: sabadh kai anahadh surat kai unamanee prem kai nijhar dhaar sahaj ravan kai ||

en.bdb: By plentiful practicing of meditation on Guru's teachings, the mind starts listening to the unstruck melody. As a result, it changes its stance and becomes God-oriented. Then one relishes the continuous flow of the divine nectar that is produced as a result of celestial love.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਕੁਟੀ ਉਲੰਘਿ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਸੰਜੋਗ ਭੋਗ ਦਸਮ ਸਥਲ ਨਿਹਕੇਵਲ ਭਵਨ ਕੈ ॥੨੯੧॥
verses.translit_en: tirakuTee ula(n)gh sukh saagar sa(n)jog bhog dhasam sathal nihakeval bhavan kai ||291||

en.bdb: By crossing the confluence of three nerves, one enjoys the bliss of meeting the Lord. The mystical door there is the unique place of enjoying peace, union, relishment and pleasure. (291)
